name: Martin Sigler
about: Martin Sigler is a Berlin-based writer specialising in culture, philosophy, and identity. His work focuses on the everyday, offering pragmatic approaches to how Black individuals can emancipate themselves today. After completing a Master's degree in Culture, Criticism and Curation at Central Saint Martins, he published I Am the Performative Object, a book exploring the articulation between performative objects and the construction of Black identity.
